name: TxDOT Austin
text: TRAFFIC ALERT: Southbound I-35 Riverside Drive bypass lane will be closed Monday, Oct. 19, from 8 p.m. to 6 a.m., for drainage work. Drivers on the southbound I-35 frontage road will use the traffic signal at Riverside Drive to continue south. #My35 #ATXtraffic pic.twitter.com/WbPjs3gLTz
